Every meal is made with fresh ingredients and served with warm baladi bread. At SEC Restaurant, we bring authentic Egyptian flavors with quality and care in every bite.

about_section.title: About Us
about_section.description: Set El Kol restaurant was established in 2024 with the aim of preserving authentic Egyptian cuisine and presenting it with a modern spirit, where we blend traditional flavors with contemporary presentation styles in an atmosphere inspired by the old Egyptian home, using fresh local ingredients and inherited cooking methods to offer our guests a warm dining experience that reflects Egypt’s identity in a way that suits our present time...

mission.title: Our Mission
mission.description: To preserve and share the rich culinary heritage of Egypt while embracing modern dining experiences.

vision.title: Our Vision
vision.description: To become the premier destination for authentic Egyptian cuisine, known for quality and innovation.

privacy_policy.title: Privacy Policy
privacy_policy.label: Legal

sections.title: Introduction
before: This Privacy Policy explains how our restaurant backend system collects, processes, stores, and protects personal information when customers place orders through our ordering services.
We respect your privacy and are committed to handling your information responsibly.

sections.title: Information We Collect
before: When you use our ordering services, we may collect the following information:

items.label: Order Information:
items.text: Ordered items, quantities, selected add-ons, prices, and order details.

items.label: Order History:
items.text: Previous orders, order timestamps, and order statuses.

items.label: Technical Information:
items.text: Information received through system requests and integrations, such as transaction identifiers and webhook events.

after: We only collect information necessary to operate and manage the restaurant's ordering system.

sections.title: WhatsApp Bot Usage
before: Our WhatsApp bot is strictly intended for internal restaurant management purposes.

items.text: The bot is not intended for public use or customer interaction.
It is exclusively operated by the restaurant owner.
Only one authorized person, the restaurant owner, is intended to use the bot.
The bot is used to receive order notifications, review incoming orders, and manage their statuses and related restaurant operations.

after: Customers do not need to interact with the WhatsApp bot to place orders.

sections.title: How We Use Your Information
before: Collected information is used exclusively for legitimate restaurant operations, including:

items.text: Notifying restaurant management about incoming orders.
Managing menu items, availability, and additional options.
Preventing duplicate orders and maintaining system reliability.

sections.title: Data Storage and Security
before: Order information is stored in a secured database used by the restaurant backend.
We implement reasonable technical and organizational measures to protect stored information against unauthorized access, alteration, disclosure, or destruction.
Access to management functionality is restricted to authorized personnel.
However, no online system or method of electronic storage can guarantee absolute security.

sections.title: Third-Party Services
before: Our system may rely on third-party providers to operate, including:

items.label: WhatsApp / Meta:
items.text: For internal management notifications and related messaging functionality.

items.label: Database and Hosting Providers:
items.text: For securely storing information and operating the backend infrastructure.

after: These providers may process information as necessary to provide their respective services, subject to their own privacy policies and terms.
We do not sell or rent customer personal information to third parties.

sections.title: Data Retention
before: Customer and order information may be retained for as long as reasonably necessary for restaurant operations, order history, recordkeeping, and other legitimate business purposes.
Information that is no longer required may be deleted when appropriate.

sections.title: Your Privacy Rights
before: You may request information about the personal data we hold about you, request corrections to inaccurate information, or request deletion of your personal information where applicable.
Such requests can be submitted through the restaurant's official contact channels.

sections.title: Changes to This Policy
before: We reserve the right to update this Privacy Policy when necessary to reflect changes in our services, technology, or applicable requirements.
Any updates will be published with a revised effective date.

sections.title: Contact Information
before: For questions, concerns, or requests regarding this Privacy Policy or your personal information, please contact the restaurant through its official communication channels.

privacy_policy.acknowledgement: By using our ordering services, you acknowledge that you have read and understood this Privacy Policy.
